extName.message: Mooogor Start - Efficient New Tab Launcher

extDescription.message: Mooogor Start is a new tab page built to help you jump into your next task faster—open frequently used sites, search across sources, or restore recently closed tabs.

nt_permission_desc_bookmarks.message: After authorizing, you can browse or search your saved bookmarks.

nt_permission_desc_history.message: After authorizing, you can browse or search your history.

nt_settings_new_tab_open.message: Open links in a new tab

nt_settings_new_tab_tip.message: Automatically enabled when pinned to the tab bar.

nt_no_pinned_desc.message: Click + in the top-left to add favourites, or right-click in Bookmarks/History to add.

nt_about_name_origin_desc.message:
Mooogor is a homophone of "Moge'er," a Sichuan phrase from China, which means "pickpocket."
The name carries a bit of self-deprecating humor, and it also reflects an attitude. In software development, we all use work created by other developers to some extent: open-source frameworks, utility libraries, design thinking, and various free resources.
I also used many open-source projects while building Mooogor. I believe you also benefit from these outcomes directly or indirectly in daily work. In a sense, we all "borrow" from prior experience and keep creating new value.

nt_about_design_goal_desc.message:
I have used many new tab pages, and most of them keep getting more complex, like a mini desktop. The features are rich, but they also make it easy to stay on the page and slow down getting started.
I want the new tab page to be a simple, direct entry point. Open it, quickly find the website you need, and move on instead of being interrupted by extra information.
So Mooogor Start will stay restrained and prioritize features that help you start faster, rather than designs that increase dwell time.
If you have any ideas or suggestions, feel free to email me:

nt_about_free_desc.message:
Mooogor Start is free.
If future features must rely on cloud services (such as cross-device sync), there may be an optional paid plan because cloud services have ongoing costs. For security and privacy, I will prioritize local offline implementations.
If Mooogor Start helps you save time, you are also welcome to support it, which gives me more motivation to keep improving this product.
